$schemaNote: Tracks MCP SEP-1649 server-card draft (revision 2025-05). Update field names as the spec lands.

authentication.note: Public, no auth, no API key. Rate limited to 60 requests / 5 minutes per IP.

tools.name: search_swedish_ai
tools.description: Hybrid semantic + lexical search across RISE and AI Sweden publications (Swedish and English). Filters: source, lang, page_type. Limit 1–50 (default 20).

tools.name: find_mentions
tools.description: Lexical 'everything that mentions X' primitive: stemmed tsquery + exact-substring fallback. Includes a parity total. Filters: source, lang, page_type. Limit 1–100 (default 25).

tools.name: list_latest
tools.description: Newest indexed documents across both sources; lightweight metadata only. Filters: source, lang, page_type. Limit 1–50 (default 20).

tools.name: find_similar
tools.description: Given an indexed URL, return semantically nearest other documents.

tools.name: get_document
tools.description: Full cleaned markdown for a single indexed URL.

tools.name: list_sources
tools.description: Sources covered, document counts, language breakdown, last-updated.

tools.name: server_info
tools.description: Server identity and scope: name, origin, verifiable-response spec id, build version, dataset statistics (documents per source, chunks), last-updated.

signing.signed: wrapper { iat, payload, payload_digest, content_digest, provenance }
signing.envelope: result._meta["org.jardenberg/verifiable-mcp"] = { spec, alg, kid, signed, jws } — no security-bearing values outside the JWS
signing.payload_digest: sha256 over the RFC 8785 canonical payload (inside the signed wrapper)
signing.content_binding: content_digest (inside the signed wrapper) = sha256 over the exact served bytes of content[0].text
signing.cardPathNote: The /.well-known/mcp.json server-card path follows SEP-1649, not yet frozen upstream; the path may change. Both the card and the dedicated key file are served.
signing.deprecated: v0.1 result.signature over structuredContent and the in-payload provenance mirror are still emitted; removed in v0.3.
signing.note: Signed errors: JSON-RPC error frames carry the envelope at error.data["org.jardenberg/verifiable-mcp"]; the signed payload is { id, error } with the envelope removed. Tool-level isError results are signed as { isError: true, message }. Unsigned fallback if the key is unavailable.

provenance.legal_basis: Indexed under the EU TDM exception (DSM directive, art. 4); excerpts served with source attribution; all content remains © its publisher
